title: Graph document
description: Kind-agnostic graph document for a node editor. Structure and payload live in `nodes` and `edges`; presentation lives in the parallel `view` collection; domain semantics live in the node type registry, not here.
$comment: Core objects use additionalProperties:false to catch field typos. Forward compatibility is a code obligation, not a schema one: when reading a document whose schemaVersion minor is higher than yours, validate against a relaxed copy of this schema (additionalProperties:true on Node/Edge) and preserve unknown fields on write. Cross-record invariants that JSON Schema cannot express (map key equals record id, acyclic parent chains, endpoint existence, port direction compatibility, key uniqueness among siblings, arity bounds, view key resolution) are INV-1 through INV-11 and must be enforced in the reducer.

schemaVersion.description: Semver over the core model only. Registry types version independently.

kind.description: Selects a ruleset in the registry and filters the palette. Advisory only; the editor must not branch on it.

nodes.description: Keyed by node id. INV-1: the key must equal the record's id.

edges.description: Keyed by edge id. INV-1: the key must equal the record's id.

id.description: Opaque, immutable, never reused. ULID (Crockford base32) or UUID. Both sort lexicographically by creation time when using ULID or UUIDv7.

key.description: Human-facing handle, mutable, unique among siblings only (INV-6). Carries the Mermaid identifier on import. Never referenced by edges.

typeRef.description: Registry key. Namespace prefix by convention: core.*, flow.*, seq.*, er.*, story.*

rank.description: Fractional index (LexoRank style) for sibling ordering. Sort by rank, tiebreak by id. Structural, not presentational: it must survive a reset-layout command.

state.description: active participates in layout and traversal. detached is retained with its wiring intact so it can be reattached; it is not a tombstone.

ext.description: Extension surface for consumers other than core. Core never reads it; unrecognised keys must survive read-modify-write untouched.

propertyNames.$comment: Reverse-DNS namespace, e.g. com.acme.costing or org.mermaid.style

meta.description: Document-level ambient metadata. Open by design.

revision.description: Monotonic counter. Memoisation key for all derived indexes.

role.description: Renderer and exporter hint. A true/false pair maps to labelled edges off a Mermaid diamond.

max.description: null is unbounded. max:1 on an out-port is what triggers automatic branch/split node insertion.

group.description: This port is a template for a dynamic set (a split's N outputs), instantiated as port.0, port.1, …

dataType.description: Reserved for typed connections. Not enforced in v1.

portMap.description: Instance ports. Overrides or extends the registry defaults for this node's type; omit entirely to inherit them.

recordSource.description: Import provenance. Write-once at import; never updated by the editor.

originalKey.description: Set when an imported key was suffixed to resolve a collision.

text.description: Full original source. Enough to regenerate or diff later without storing a CST.

warnings.description: Constructs parked in ext or skipped. Surface these in the import summary.

label.description: Deliberate exception to the data-agnostic rule: the one content field core may read, for search, breadcrumbs, minimap and accessibility names.

parent.description: Containment. Any node may be a parent (D4). INV-2: chains are acyclic and terminate at null.

data.description: Domain payload. Opaque to core; validated against the type's dataSchema in the registry and read only by the registered component.

parent.description: Grouping container. A sequence alt block contains messages, not participants, so edges need containment too.

view.description: Authored presentation, parallel to structure (D9). Every entry is optional; absent means 'derive it'. Separate collection so geometry churn stays out of semantic diffs, out of the structural undo stack, and out of exports.

x.description: Absent means unplaced; the layout engine assigns. A fresh import emits no coordinates.

w.description: Present only when the user explicitly resized. Absent means measure the component's intrinsic size, so content edits are never fought by a stale value.

collapsed.description: Pure view state. Because edges are level-local with portals (INV-5), collapsing rewrites no edges.

lockChildren.description: Skip auto-layout for this subtree. Layout policy only. If the information would be destroyed by a reset-layout command it is not presentation and belongs in rank instead.

style.description: Per-instance overrides only. Anything that should change for every node of a type belongs in the registry.
